notes.title: Major Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42544928/7966ccb101ea889a8117523d3bd412223c6499ff.png

Changelog


 [spoiler]Calisto[/spoiler] discovery about the Enigma of Fear is now available in the Cathedral from [spoiler]Jaser perspective[/spoiler] 
 Now it is possible to choose text and audio language separately 
 The [spoiler]Eye of the God of Fear[/spoiler] now has more details about [spoiler]its function[/spoiler] 
 Improvements to the pistol aiming system 
 Adds Lupi's rug in the Basement 
 Adjustment of Mia's portraits in dialogue after [spoiler] Transcending [/spoiler] 
 Small adjustments to evidence 
 Mia no longer exits stealth mode when switching items
 New art of Goliath and Abraham in the Strach Mansion 
 Small adjustments to the Mental Map 
 Adjustment in which the HUD in the [spoiler]Eye of the God of Fear[/spoiler] room would not appear correctly in specific resolutions 
 Texture optimization and memory usage 
 Added SteamDeck support


Although most of the performance issues and bugs have been addressed, we will keep listening to your feedbacks and providing support. 

If you wanna get in touch with us, visit our Discord.

notes.title: BUG Fix and Performance Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42544928/7966ccb101ea889a8117523d3bd412223c6499ff.png

Changelog

 General game optimizations (loading times, textures and FPS)
 Fixed the infinite shooting bug
 Fixed bugs that could occur during the Castle boss fight
 Balanced the perception sensitivity of the Blood Zombie
 Fixed small bugs using the "Pet Lupi" mechanic
 Revision of collisions in the Perimeter, Exterior Castle and Exterior Mansion as Verity
 Fixed an issue that could cause unexpected behaviours on Lupi
 Fixed ammo boxes and medkits to respawn correctly
 Fixed the issue that allowed players to carry more than 3 medkits
 Adjustments to Samuel's Terminal
 Fixed bugs and made adjustments in the Mind Map
 Adjustment on the battle difficulty against the Cathedral boss
 Fixed Verity's HP and ammo bugs
 Adjustments to evidence, tombs, recorder and HUD
 Adjustments to the final cutscene so that [spoiler]Lupi[/spoiler] always appears correctly
 Adjustments to Mia losing important inventory items after dying
 Adjustments on audio in the Other Ending
 Added saving points after getting the [spoiler] Déjà Vu Radio [/spoiler] and when [spoiler]Transcending[/spoiler]


Although some performance issues have been addressed, optimization work continues. For more feedback and to report bugs, visit our Discord.

notes.title: BUG Fix
BUG Fix
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42544928/7966ccb101ea889a8117523d3bd412223c6499ff.png

Changelog


 Fixed achievements that were not displaying correctly. 
 Added a new achievement related to the [spoiler]Cursed Puzzles [/spoiler]. 
 Fixed the issue that caused freezing in the [spoiler]Final Sword[/spoiler]. 
 Fixed the Keyboard in the [spoiler]Cursed Puzzles [/spoiler] terminal. 
 Fixed the issue that caused the [spoiler]Samuel[/spoiler] ritual to happen before intended. 
 Fixed some Perimeter maps that were not behaving as they should.
 General Music and Sound adjustments. 
 Fixed the behavior of the [spoiler]Cemetery Box[/spoiler].
 General Visual adjustments (Evidence, UI and Portrait). 
 Fixed Mia's respawn at a specific point in the Cave. General pause screen fixes.
 Fixed general Mind Map bugs. 
 Fixed collisions that caused the player to leave the scene limit. 
 Fixed a potential softlock in the [spoiler]Jaser[/spoiler] cycle. 
 General fixes to the [spoiler]Goliath[/spoiler] door. 
 Added FPS Limit Option. 
 Balancing Cursed Puzzles of [spoiler]Butter on Butter[/spoiler].


There are no plans to make Lupi speak. Please stop asking.

We are aware of some performance issues causing the game to take a long time to open or experience low FPS in certain areas. We are planning to release a compatibility and optimization patch soon. 

If you have more feedbacks, visit our Discord.

notes.title: BUG Fix
Major BUG Fix
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42544928/7966ccb101ea889a8117523d3bd412223c6499ff.png

Changelog

 Mindmap is activated
 Fixing evidence that persisted invisible after a Graveyard Boss Fight
 Adjusting dialogue being unlocked early in Spiral CastleIt 
 Fixing Transcend softlock 
 The ritual book is now no longer invisible to Transcend
 Collision adjustments to prevent the player from falling.
 Checking for a bug in specific situations where the Underground’s Numeric Keypads did not work even with the correct password.
 Lupi’s dialogue fixed.
 Dialogues localization bugs.
 Fixed bug that caused Mia to dangle in front of a door in the Underground.
 Echoes sprites and portrait fixes.
 Minor adjustments and text corrections in several pieces of evidence.
 Activating the tombstones in a certain sequence within the Labyrinth that was appearing without tombstones before.
 The specific sequence now can be repeated forever, as it should be.
 Adjustments to the credits screen.
 “Butter on Butter” Collectable Puzzle is now fixed
 Collision adjustments to prevent the player from getting stuck in some areas.
 When defeated in the last Boss Fight, it is no longer necessary to redo the entire initial sequence again.


We are aware of some performance issues causing the game to take a long time to open or experience low FPS in certain areas. We are planning to release a compatibility and optimization patch soon.

If you have more feedbacks, visit our Discord.
